description: Validate a product feed written for OpenAI's product feed schema (the format ChatGPT shopping ingests) row by row: the eleven required fields, the accepted availability values, the "amount CURRENCY" price format, URLs, GTIN length and check digit, duplicate item IDs, variant groups, checkout fields and legacy column names. Accepts CSV, TSV, JSONL or a JSON array as text and returns counts plus each finding with the first affected rows. Use it to check a feed, or a sample of one, before a merchant uploads it. It checks the file only; it cannot tell whether URLs load or what the upload itself will accept.

feed.description: The feed as text: CSV or TSV with a header row, JSONL (one object per line), or a JSON array of objects.

format.description: The file format. Leave as "auto" unless detection guesses wrong.

name: product_feed_validate
title: Validate a ChatGPT product feed
